title: Question on the page "hits"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[hits](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hits.html)".

I'm trying to figure out how to customize the search snippets. I need to limit the results from {{{\_highlightResult.question.value}}} and {{{\_highlightResult.message.value}}} to a small number of characters. The full result of {{{\_highlightResult.message.value}}} is a large page of text.

I've found other documentation for snippeting, but the examples don't use instantsearch they seem to use the main api or the index, all the code examples are like index.addSetting().

Thanks.
